questions.question: Sami calls Mina: 'I have a patient with a 4-unit bridge that has moved! What should I do?' Mina replies:
options: Check the abutments, cement, and occlusion
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'A long bridge that moves may hide an abutment, cement, or occlusion problem.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will do a complete assessment.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage a patient with a maxillary prosthesis that no longer stays in place?' Mina advises him:
options: Check the adaptation, retention, and occlusion
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Loss of retention can be due to wear, resorption, or an occlusion defect.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will do a reline before considering implants.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'When to use a conventional bridge rather than an implant?' Mina replies:
options: When the abutments are healthy and the patient does not want surgery
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The conventional bridge is an option when the abutments are healthy and the patient refuses implantology.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will present both options to the patient.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage a removable prosthesis fracture?' Mina replies:
options: Evaluate the fracture: repairable or not
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Some fractures are repairable, others require a remake.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will evaluate the extent of the fracture.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What are the advantages of an implant-supported prosthesis?' Mina replies:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Implant-supported prostheses offer stability, comfort, and bone preservation.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will propose an implant-supported prosthesis for this patient.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage a crown that has a different color from the adjacent teeth?' Mina replies:
options: Evaluate if a color correction is possible
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'A color correction at the laboratory may sometimes suffice.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will send the crown back to the lab.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is a removable prosthesis reline?' Mina replies:
options: A complete remake of the prosthesis
The renewal of the prosthesis base to improve adaptation
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Reline corrects adaptation defects due to bone resorption.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will do a reline for this patient.'

questions.question: Sami and Mina discuss bonded bridges. Mina says: 'They are conservative.' Sami asks: 'What is their disadvantage?'
options: They have less longevity than conventional bridges
They are more difficult to place
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Bonded bridges have less longevity than conventional bridges.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will propose a conventional bridge for this patient.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage a mandibular complete denture that floats?' Mina replies:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Mandibular prosthesis instability is often due to an occlusion or adaptation defect.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will first adjust the occlusion.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is CAD/CAM in prosthetics?' Mina replies:
options: Computer-aided design and manufacturing of prostheses
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'CAD/CAM allows designing and manufacturing prostheses digitally.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will train in CAD/CAM.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage a patient who has lost their removable prosthesis?' Mina replies:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Loss of a prosthesis requires making a new one.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will take new impressions.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What are the advantages of zirconia over metal-ceramic?' Mina replies:
options: Better aesthetics and absence of metal
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Zirconia offers superior aesthetics without metal, but at a higher cost.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will propose zirconia for anterior teeth.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage a fractured bridge?' Mina replies:
options: Evaluate if a repair is possible
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Bridge fractures can sometimes be repaired.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will evaluate the fracture.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is a hybrid prosthesis?' Mina replies:
options: A fixed implant-supported prosthesis with a resin base and ceramic teeth
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The hybrid prosthesis combines the stability of implants with the aesthetics of ceramic.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will propose a hybrid prosthesis for this patient.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage a broken temporary crown?' Mina replies:
options: Place the definitive one right away
Remake a temporary while waiting for the definitive one
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The temporary must be remade to protect the tooth while waiting for the definitive one.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will remake a temporary.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What are the signs of abnormal wear of a prosthesis?' Mina replies:
options: Loss of material, cracks, or fractures
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Abnormal wear manifests as loss of material or fractures.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will monitor the wear of my prostheses.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage a patient who wants veneers but has very dark teeth?' Mina replies:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Prior bleaching can improve the result of the veneers.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will propose bleaching first.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is an All-on-4 prosthesis?' Mina replies:
options: A fixed prosthesis on 4 implants, two straight and two tilted
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The All-on-4 technique uses 4 implants to support a fixed prosthesis.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will train in the All-on-4 technique.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage a deformed removable prosthesis?' Mina replies:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'A deformation can sometimes be corrected, but often requires a remake.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will evaluate if a correction is possible.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What are the risks of poor occlusion in prosthetics?' Mina replies:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Poor occlusion can cause many problems.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will always balance the occlusion.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage a fixed prosthesis that bothers the patient?' Mina replies:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Discomfort is often due to an occlusion or adaptation defect.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will check the occlusion.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is articulation?' Mina replies:
options: The movements of the jaw and their relationship with the teeth
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Articulation is essential in prosthetics to respect masticatory dynamics.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will study my patients' articulation.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage a patient with a metal allergy?' Mina replies:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Patients allergic to metals should receive metal-free prostheses.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will propose zirconia to this patient.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is the recommended follow-up for a prosthesis?' Mina replies:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Annual follow-up allows early detection of problems.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will plan annual check-ups.'

questions.question: Sami, after having tackled complex prosthetic cases with Mina, says: 'I am proud of our successes!' Mina concludes: 'Advanced techniques are...'
options: The key to restoring smile and function
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Advanced techniques are the key to restoring smile and function.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will continue to improve.'
